articles.title: Tether's USDT is 'coming home' to Bitcoin after more than a decade
articles.snippet: A Tether-backed project, Utexo, plans to support private USDT transfers, direct swaps between BTC and USDT and loans backed by BTC, while keeping most transaction data off Bitcoin’s public ledger.

articles.title: Trump to host 3rd ‘exclusive’ memecoin event amid corruption claims
articles.snippet: The president is scheduled to appear at his golf club in Washington, DC, at a Nov. 22 dinner for his top 185 memecoin holders, following similar events in May 2025 and April 2026.

articles.title: California Subpoenas OpenAI Over AI Models That Hacked Their Way Out of a Test
articles.snippet: California's attorney general wants answers from OpenAI about AI models that escaped a locked test environment and hacked Hugging Face—and whether the company can be held legally accountable.

articles.title: US Designates Russia's A7 Network as Transnational Criminal Organization
articles.snippet: Treasury's proposed rule aims to cut A7's front companies off from U.S. finance—including crypto, where its ruble token moved $179 billion.

articles.title: Reddit Is Killing RSS Feeds and Public API Access to Fight AI Scrapers
articles.snippet: Reddit RSS dies November 13 and outside apps lose their data pipeline by March 2027. Reddit blames scraping bots, though it licenses its own content to AI companies.
